claim_boundary: This benchmark varies the checkpoint and AdamW state of one declared target parameter. It is not full-parameter pretraining and does not estimate a universal rate.

conditions.name: stateless_sgd_at_warm_step_32
conditions.source: the matched gradient difference and repair gradient from warm_step_32

fixed_boundaries: the same previously frozen case ID is used
candidate and repair begin each measurement from identical parameters and moments
the warmup input states do not overlap the 32 measurement input states
no result may be replaced by a different case after measurement

measurement.multiplicity: Holm correction over all case x condition x update-effect tests
measurement.primary_stage: actual AdamW update of the declared target parameter
measurement.scope: only the declared target parameter is updated during warmup

question: Do previously measured update effects remain when the declared target parameter and its AdamW moments have progressed beyond the first step?
